eyebrow: with: the safe way to open a file
code:
with open("notes.txt", "r") as file:
    contents = file.read()
    print(contents)
# File is automatically closed here
caption: Guarantees the file closes even if an error happens partway through.

code:
with open("notes.txt", "w") as file:
    file.write("First line\n")

with open("log.txt", "a") as file:
    file.write("New log entry\n")
caption: "w" erases prior contents; "a" adds to the end. Pick deliberately.

code:
import json

data = {"model": "gpt-4o", "temperature": 0.7}
with open("config.json", "w") as file:
    json.dump(data, file)

with open("config.json", "r") as file:
    loaded = json.load(file)
caption: No manual string handling needed — json reads/writes the file.

code:
json.dump(data, file)     # writes to an open FILE
json.load(file)           # reads from an open FILE
